card.name: Partway through enzyme-related terms
card.fires_on: Marks partway through terms about enzymes or biochemical agents, such as -ase endings, ferment, or binding resins. It also fires on scattered mid-term pieces of drug names.

modes.label: Enzyme names
modes.description: Fires on -ase endings or ferment- in enzyme or process terms.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Fires on middle pieces of drug or class names.

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: Fires on a modifier word that precedes a biochemical noun.
modes.example: Bile Acid<< Binding>> Resins Bile acid binding resins

card.writes: It suppresses the word enzyme, so it likely signals that an enzyme term has just been written or is not needed next.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of enzyme-type words and some drug names, when the term is already under way.
